dataset: Planetary Boundaries — control variables and status
sourceName: Richardson et al. (2023), Science Advances; Stockholm Resilience Centre / Planetary Health Check (2024–25)
citation: Richardson, K., Steffen, W., Lucht, W., et al. (2023). Earth beyond six of nine planetary boundaries. Science Advances 9(37): eadh2458. Zone-of-uncertainty ranges from Steffen et al. (2015), Science 347:1259855. Ocean-acidification update: Findlay et al. (2025), Global Change Biology / Planetary Health Check 2025.
note: Global (not per-country) framework. As of the 2025 assessment, SEVEN of nine boundaries are transgressed — ocean acidification was formally assessed as crossed in 2025. Each boundary also has a zone of uncertainty (the band of increasing risk between the safe limit and the high-risk end); values transcribed from the published assessments, none invented.

boundaries.name: Climate change (energy imbalance)
boundaries.controlVariable: Radiative forcing at top of atmosphere

boundaries.name: Biosphere integrity (functional)
boundaries.controlVariable: Human appropriation of net primary production (HANPP)

boundaries.name: Freshwater change (green water)
boundaries.controlVariable: Land area with root-zone soil-moisture departures

boundaries.name: Ocean acidification
boundaries.note: Formally assessed as crossed in 2025 — the 7th boundary outside the safe operating space. Polar/Arctic waters (Ω 1–2) are already far below; tropics (Ω 3.3–4.0) remain higher. Source: Findlay et al. (2025) / Planetary Health Check 2025.
boundaries.source: Findlay et al. (2025), Global Change Biology; Planetary Health Check 2025

boundaries.name: Novel entities
boundaries.controlVariable: Synthetic chemicals / novel substances released without adequate safety assessment
boundaries.current: Boundary exceeded (no safe operating space quantified)
